_comment: WeaponSkill -> animation-cycle mapping. The OWNER GOAL: animation is determined by JOB TYPE + WEAPON-SKILL, so each class skill plays its matching swing/cast instead of one generic Cast trigger. KEYS: 'class' is the abilities.json class id (mage|knight|ranger|cleric; Wizard art folder == mage, Healer art folder == cleric). 'skill' is the weaponskill name from Resources/HudIcons/<Class>/ (the per-class skill icon set the HUD shows). 'slot' (q/w/e/r) ties the skill to the abilities.json ability that fires it (this is what the runtime actually casts today — the skill name is the design label for that slot). RUNTIME CONTRACT: 'trigger' is the canonical AnimParams verb the ActorAnimator must fire (Cast|Attack|WindUp|Victory|Block). 'combo' (>=0) is the Combo int set BEFORE an Attack trigger so a multi-clip class (Knight) plays a DIFFERENT swing per skill via the Attack0/1/2 states the HeroAnimatorFactory builds. 'clip' is the Assets/Action FBX basename the factory should bind to that state. 'clipExists'=true means the FBX is present today; false means MISSING -> 'fallbackClip' (an existing clip) is used until art lands. This file is the SINGLE source the HeroAnimatorFactory reads to build per-skill states AND the runtime (HeroAbilities / BattleController) reads to pick the right trigger+combo per cast. Dual-copy: Resources copy WINS at load; keep StreamingAssets copy in sync.

_notes.knight: Knight has the RICHEST clip set (10+ melee swings) -> full per-skill coverage achievable now. Each skill maps to a distinct Attack combo index; HeroAnimatorFactory must be extended from 3 Attack states to 4 (one per skill) OR reuse 3 + 1 cast-style for Charge.
_notes.ranger: Ranger is the BIGGEST GAP: only Ranger_Aim_Idle exists (no draw/fire/volley/trap clips). Every ranger skill falls back to the aim pose today. Needs 3-4 bow clips retargeted via HeroAnimatorFactory before per-skill coverage is real.
_notes.wizard: Wizard (mage) has 12 cast clips -> easy per-skill distinct casts (1H/2H/area variants). Currently the factory only binds one (Wizard_Spell_Cast).
_notes.healer: No Healer art folder + abilities.json has NO cleric class (Cleric routes to mage loadout in code). Only Wizard_Heal exists for healing. Smite/Holy/Group_Heal reuse Wizard cast clips until a Healer set is acquired.
